hero.title: Rent Our Space for Your Own Event
hero.body: Looking for a versatile space in Nusa Dua to run your own class, shoot, or event? Raja Bali's garden and private room are available to rent by the hour, for you to use exactly as you need, no restaurant event required.

garden.heading: The Garden
garden.subheading: An open-air space for movement, gatherings, and pop-ups
garden.imageAlt: Raja Bali's outdoor garden space, available for rent
garden.body: Our garden is an open-air setting with natural shade and room to move, well suited to activities that need space to breathe, whether that's a sunrise yoga session, a styled photoshoot, or an evening of live entertainment under the stars.

privateRoom.heading: The Private Room
privateRoom.subheading: An indoor space for meetings, training, and focused work
privateRoom.imageAlt: Raja Bali's private indoor room, available for rent
privateRoom.body: A quiet, air-conditioned indoor space set apart from the main restaurant, suited to work that needs a closed door and a table, from a client presentation to a full-day workshop.
